LOCAL 326
CIPHER TELEGRAM FROM BERNE
1537
1. YOUR TELEGRAM 3272.
NEITHER ROBERT NOR WE UNDERSTAND? MEANING OF PARA 5.
PLEASE CLARIFY.
2.? ROBERT ALSO WISHES TO KNOW OF HIS TELEGRAMS TO ECLAIR ARE PASSED ON QUICKLY OR HELD UP.
TP. 1135 JEW. 25.5.43.
